text: Implemented standard-domain BLAS masked Sinkhorn with automatic log-domain fallback and explicit backend control. Focused Transport court: 105 passes, including 12 randomized projection differential cases, extreme-range fallback, full-alignment equivalence, symmetry, chronology, and convergence. Microbenchmarks show 6.3x production-style pair speedup (identical displayed log score); optimized full fold 3 completed 315/315 finite and 100% converged in 830.849s versus reference folds at 2859.838s and 3485.042s (3.44x to 4.19x end-to-end).
